[LSTO.4.7.1] **The engine owns the cache.** The authoritative current
value of every key is engine state, held in an in-engine key-value
map alongside working memory. `cached()` ([LSTO.4.3.1]) is an
engine-local read — a peer of `now()` / `monotonic_ns()` — served from
that map with no callback and no round-trip. The integration owns
only durability ([LSTO.4.5.2]): an optional write-through that
persists the engine's cache and re-seeds it on startup.
